targetCohort: Indian skincare beginners and routine-switchers who want a simple way to observe whether their face usually leans oily, dry, balanced, or mixed.
awarenessStage: Problem aware; confused by shifting oil, dryness, and sensitivity language.
readerTakeaway: Your observations can suggest a baseline pattern, but skin changes through weather, routine, and other factors; use the result as a starting point, not a diagnosis.
objections: I get a shiny nose but dry cheeks—does one label fit?
What if my skin behaves differently this month?
I do not want to buy a routine just because a quiz gave me a type.
ctaConnection: After observing the baseline pattern, readers can use MyMirror to organise the visible signals they want to prioritise.

judgmentChecks.notes: Built from live reader language and the approved non-diagnostic MyMirror position.
